name: @meir-labs/skill-web-performance
description: The meirlabs web-performance skill — make a Next.js site as fast as possible: ship less and load it in parallel, feel instant, stay smooth. Distilled from the Linear "how is it so fast" teardown, with a measure-first audit loop, per-route Core Web Vitals budgets, and a CI guard that fails a build on regression. npx installs it into .claude/skills.
author: Meir Rosenschein
